project.title: Metric learning for human-motion retrieval
project.researchQuestion: Does contextual similarity learning improve motion retrieval relative to the full image-paper comparison roster, including Multi-Similarity with and without mining?
project.summary: A controlled motion-domain replication: contextual versus contrastive development first, followed by all 26 declared configurations with a common fine-tuned MotionBERT backbone. The current dates are a provisional planning horizon, subject to measured resources and complete method coverage.

protocol.bindingSource: docs/protocol/protocol-v2.md and configs/benchmark.v2.yaml supersede the v1 three-method robustness scope. configs/benchmark-methods.v2.json declares all 26 configurations. Preserve the final tracked prospectus, v1 protocol and historical evidence; docs/protocol/independent-research.md remains the governance rule.
protocol.successDefinition: Success is a complete, fair and reproducible comparison, including null or negative results. Neither Contextual nor Multi-Similarity is presumed superior. Unimplemented methods remain visible blockers, never substituted or silently omitted.

lockedDecisions.label: Research focus
lockedDecisions.value: Contextual similarity learning is the method introduced by the screenshot paper. Multi-Similarity (MS) and MS with its miner are separate required comparators.

lockedDecisions.label: Priority phase
lockedDecisions.value: Implement and run Contextual versus its exact contrastive component first, using auxiliary training and held-out development actions only. Complete correctness, memory and runtime checks before broadening. This does not open the novel test.

lockedDecisions.label: Required coverage
lockedDecisions.value: 26 declared configurations: Contrastive, Contextual, Triplet, MS, MS + miner, Proxy Anchor, Proxy NCA, ROADMAP, NT-Xent, FastAP, SmoothAP, normalized softmax, Proxy NCA++, SupCon, DRML, DIML, DiVA, IBC, S2SD, Proxy NCA + Metrix, PA + Metrix, MS + Metrix, HIST, MHGL, PA + AVSL, and Contextual at 1,536 dimensions.

lockedDecisions.label: Encoder and dimensions
lockedDecisions.value: Main experiment fine-tunes one common pretrained MotionBERT backbone. Compare 24 configurations at 512 dimensions; compare PA + AVSL and Contextual separately at 1,536 dimensions. Preserve required architecture-specific components. Frozen-encoder work is a supplementary pilot.

lockedDecisions.label: Test seal
lockedDecisions.value: All 156 main and 276 secondary final method/seed runs, selection decisions, training attempts and checkpoints must be complete and hash-bound before any novel-test evaluation. A partial two-method opening is forbidden.

lockedDecisions.label: Workload and calendar
lockedDecisions.value: The 14 records through December 18 are a planning horizon. Forecast all 1,176 completed training runs, evaluations, validation, immutable segments, failures and researcher work. The theoretical completed encoder-checkpoint floor alone is 599.27 GB before heads and segments; the full campaign exceeds the previously observed available project storage. Resolve storage and measured runtime before full launch, preserving artifacts and the novel-test seal.

lockedDecisions.label: Governance
lockedDecisions.value: Independent researcher decisions apply. No advisor approval is required. BU determination was researcher-confirmed on September 24; preserve that evidence. Actual hours remain unprovided and are never invented.

lockedDecisions.label: Licensing
lockedDecisions.value: The unlicensed contextual repository remains reference-only. Use independent implementations from published mathematics or explicitly licensed upstream code; record source, license, revision and adaptation for every method.

experimentalDesign.label: Main endpoint
experimentalDesign.value: Clean multi-positive retrieval on held-out NTU action classes. R@1 is primary; report R@2, R@4, R@8, mAP and mAP@R with per-query relevant counts. Candidate sets exclude self and all synchronized views of the same performance.

experimentalDesign.label: Development and final classes
experimentalDesign.value: Preserve the 80 training / 20 development auxiliary action split and the separate official 20 novel actions. Tune only on development; after lock retrain on all 100 auxiliary actions. Freeze multi-positive gallery/query construction result-blind.

experimentalDesign.label: Fairness
experimentalDesign.value: Pair six seeds, common backbone initialization, shared head initialization within compatible head recipes and dimensions, applicable data augmentation, and physical P by K batch/sample plans. Architecture methods retain their required distinct heads and scorers, whose costs are reported. Equal embedding dimensions alone do not make head initialization compatible.

experimentalDesign.label: Physical batches
experimentalDesign.value: Start with P=8 and K=4. Measure backward-pass memory for fine-tuned methods; the v1 frozen-forward profile does not prove feasibility. Freeze a common physical batch within each comparison group; gradient accumulation cannot replace contextual neighbors.

experimentalDesign.label: Tuning
experimentalDesign.value: Three predeclared candidates multiply every method-specific learning rate together by 1, 0.5 or 2, preserving rate ratios and all other settings. Six paired seeds per candidate yield 468 development runs. Mean development R@1 chooses candidate and eligible checkpoint; exact ties prefer 1, then 0.5, then 2, and the earliest eligible step. The provisional budget is 50,000 total updates including warmup. Disclose engineering pilots separately; they cannot select final recipes.

experimentalDesign.label: Seed and final-run count
experimentalDesign.value: Six paired seeds per declared main configuration: 26 by 6 = 156 main final runs. Separate predeclared studies add 276 secondary final runs; all 432 final runs must finish before novel opening. Including 468 main development and 276 secondary development runs, the plan contains 1,176 completed training runs before profiles and failures. Cross-dimension rankings are prohibited.

experimentalDesign.label: Secondary tasks
experimentalDesign.value: Official one-shot evaluates all 26 methods and six seeds. Query-only corruption evaluates Contextual and Contrastive under both official one-shot and the primary multi-positive task. A six-cell loss-component factorial and ten training robustness conditions (label noise, pose replacement and retained class fractions) require 276 development and 276 final runs, using fixed inherited recipes. The deduplicated secondary evaluation matrix has 660 cells. These are descriptive analyses; one-shot mAP equals MRR, while multi-positive mAP does not.

protocol.corruptionPrinciple: Retain v1 deterministic query-only corruption definitions as a secondary study. Do not spend the primary two-method phase on corruption experiments. Secondary runs require locked settings before novel outcomes are viewed.

corruptions.label: Coordinate jitter
corruptions.value: Independent zero-mean Gaussian xy noise at 1%, 2.5%, and 5% of each clean sequence's median torso scale.

corruptions.label: Joint or limb masking
corruptions.value: Mask 3, 6, or 8 complete joint trajectories, chosen in connected limb-first groups with a sample-derived seed.

corruptions.label: Consecutive-frame masking
corruptions.value: Zero a deterministic consecutive block of 10, 25, or 40 frames.

corruptions.label: Mask semantics
corruptions.value: Set coordinates and confidence to zero. Do not delete or resample observations. Severity zero must remain byte-identical to clean input.

corruptions.label: Amendment rule
corruptions.value: Week 5 may change a numeric level only when geometry shows an invalid, imperceptible, or degenerate input, never because of a retrieval score. Freeze any amendment before tuning ends.

protocol.primaryFormula: delta(method, seed) = R@1(Contextual, seed) - R@1(method, seed), within the same embedding-dimension group
protocol.effectFormula: Report six-seed mean R@1 and paired Contextual-minus-comparator differences; the priority comparator is Contrastive. Predeclare multiplicity treatment for the full comparator family before final lock.
analysisRules: Report every method, configuration, seed, failure and resource cost. A missing implementation prevents complete replication; never relabel a generic loss as an architecture method.

Use paired uncertainty estimates clustered by underlying performance (setup, performer, repetition, action), keeping synchronized views together. Freeze the analysis and multiplicity rule on development before opening novel outcomes.
A superiority statement requires the predeclared positive paired interval, with the familywise rule applied to broad claims. Report intervals and effect sizes even when no method clearly wins.
R@1 is a retrieval hit, not a classification score selected on the novel set. Define macro/micro aggregation, ties, exclusions and AP denominator before evaluation.
All training and configuration selection for the declared final roster precede novel-test opening. Methods cannot be added or tuned after outcomes are visible.
The historical v1 robustness matrix and its post-core MS exception do not authorize v2 final evaluation. Existing v1 commands cannot certify the v2 benchmark.
scopeExclusions: No assumption that Contextual or MS wins.
No copied image scores presented as motion results.
No silent omission or generic substitution of architecture-specific methods.
No raw-video, clinical, identity or biomechanical claims.
A single NTU dataset supports a motion-domain replication, not a claim of universal superiority across motion datasets.

tasks.title: Profile the GPU path

tasks.completionNote: Completed 2026-09-16: a real frozen MotionBERT encoder profile ran on a scheduler-assigned BU SCC A40 using dense protocol-shaped float32 inputs. Physical batch 32 completed with 2.572 GiB peak allocated, 2.855 GiB peak reserved, and an 842.164 ms median forward; batch 64 completed with 4.977 GiB allocated, 5.514 GiB reserved, and a 1,685.400 ms median. Required device, CUDA, scheduler, quota, and job-limit evidence was captured. Physical batch 32 remained selected for the v1 frozen path because protocol v1 permitted 64 only after all core methods fit. This frozen-forward result does not establish v2 fine-tuning capacity; later v2 priority profiling passed on A100 80 GB and failed with CUDA out of memory on L40S. It is compute evidence only, not preprocessing or encoder-parity evidence.

Feature caching without provenance can mix incompatible experiments.
weeks.advisorPrompt: What further fine-tuning, quota, and full-roster measurements are needed before the v2 campaign can launch?
weeks.reflection: All five Week 3 technical tasks and gates are verified complete as of 2026-09-28. SCC job 7761714, release b92e7dd88fc261c0b8585039fbe99ad67ee8b445, completed successfully on one L40S at 01:40:59Z. Fresh parity passed, both complete 95,001-row extractions were byte-identical, and all five final/development caches validated. The conservative full-input forecast is 44.12 minutes and 4.07 GiB per cache, with 3.63 GiB peak GPU and 7.65 GiB peak host memory; the declared storage reserve passed. Prior encoder and independent v1/v2 metric/test-seal evidence is preserved. BU determination remains confirmed, and both novel-test opening ledgers remained absent at the September 28 observation. Actual researcher minutes remain unreported; Week 3 stays formally open. The hosted Week 1 and 2 records were closed later on September 28 with zero minutes while their prior notes said time was unreported; those closures require researcher reconciliation and are not treated here as evidence of zero work. This completes Week 3 technical deliverables without claiming completion of the broader v2 study.
